_comment: NUMBER FOREST. Coordinates are tiles [x, y]; rects are [x, y, w, h]. Layers apply in order: base, fills, props, border. Tile codes: g grass, G tall grass (wild encounters), p path, w water, r reeds, f flowers, T tree, R rock, B hut wall, D hut door.
name: Number Forest

interactables.name: trail sign
interactables.title: TRAIL SIGN
text: RANGER CAMP. Wild MATHMON hide in the TALL GRASS, the darker, swaying patches.
East: Whisper Meadow and Mirror Pond.  South: Sum Grove and Arch Ridge, where the old stone arch waits.

interactables.name: hut door
interactables.title: ROWAN'S HUT
text: The door is warm from the sun. A note is pinned to it: 'Out on patrol. Practice makes progress! - Rowan'

interactables.name: campfire
interactables.title: CAMPFIRE
text: The fire crackles. Sparks pop in twos and threes: 2, 4, 6, 8... skip counting is just multiplication in disguise.

interactables.name: Mirror Spring
interactables.title: MIRROR SPRING
text: Cool water ripples over smooth stones. Your companion drinks and stretches.

interactables.name: stone tablet
interactables.title: STONE TABLET
text: Beneath it, someone has scratched: 'and 12 ÷ 3 = 4 undoes it!'

npcs.name: Rowan
greeting: Morning, partner! Want a friendly practice battle? Wrong answers never hurt here.
remarks: Tall grass is where the wild ones hide.
Take your time - thinking is part of the battle.
The arch only opens for steady practice.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Did you know any number times 1 is itself? 7 × 1 = 7!
When I add 9, I add 10 and take 1 away. 26 + 9 = 35!
There's a chest in the meadow. I saw it sparkle!
Halving is dividing by 2. Half of 18 is 9!
remarks: I counted 24 trees. Or was it 42?

npcs.name: Tamsin

riddle.question: Riddle me this: I caught 6 fish each morning for 4 mornings. How many fish is that?
riddle.correct: Exactly! 6 groups of 4 make 24. Take this crystal - it helps the thinking glow.
riddle.wrong: Not quite. Think of 4 mornings, each with 6 fish. Come back and try again!

lines: The spring's water restores tired companions. Rest there whenever you need.
remarks: The fish are biting... in multiples of three.
